jobs.occupation: Sales support specialist Motors & Generators, for ABB
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: Sales Manager.
Are you a technically minded team player who enjoys turning complex requirements into smart solutions? We are looking for a dedicated Sales Support Specialist to join our Motors and Generators sales team in Västerås. In this role, you’ll be a key part of the technical sales process, working closely with Area Sales and Key Account Managers, our technical support teams, and the factory to develop tailored offers that meet customer needs.
You will play a central role in reviewing specifications, translating them into optimized technical solutions, and supporting our global sales team with both expertise and structure.
Key responsibilities include:
Analyzing customer specifications and translating them into optimized technical solutions and offers
Collaborating with internal teams to prepare high-quality and tailored technical offers.
Supporting Area Sales Managers and Key account managers throughout the sales process with technical expertise
Participating in technical discussions and clarifications with customers, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and customer satisfaction

You thrive in a collaborative environment, are solution-oriented, and bring a proactive mindset to every step of the sales cycle. The role is based in Västerås, Sweden.
Qualifications for the Role
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience in a similar role is preferred, but recent graduates with a strong eagerness to learn and grow in a technical environment are also encouraged to apply.
Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of taking ownership of tasks and responsibilities.
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams locally and globally.
A structured approach to problem-solving and delivering results.
Service-oriented, flexible, and committed to understanding customer requirements to provide the best possible solution.
Fluent in English both written and spoken. Swedish is a plus.

 What’s in it for you?
We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.
More about us
ABB Motion High Power (MOHP) Division offers a comprehensive product portfolio of large AC motors and generators. From general purpose to highly customized designs, synchronous motors provide high efficiency, reliability and availability across all major industries and applications, including some in the toughest and most demanding environments. The division also has a long track record of designing and building generators for wide range of industries, including power generation, marine, oil and gas, mining, and data centers.

Are you an analytical and structured finance professional with experience in cash flow forecasting? In this role, you will take ownership of cash flow planning in large-scale projects, working closely with stakeholders across multiple functions to ensure accurate forecasts and support sound financial decision-making.
About the position
Perido are looking for a Treasury analyst for our client in Stockholm. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring accurate and reliable cash flow forecasts across large-scale projects. You will work closely with stakeholders across finance, procurement, contracts and project delivery, gathering and analysing financial information to support effective cash flow planning and decision-making.
Your daily tasks
As a Treasury Analyst, you will be responsible for coordinating and managing the project cash flow forecasting process from start to finish. You will gather information from multiple project teams and workstreams, analyse payment schedules and contractual terms, and translate these into reliable cash flow forecasts. The role involves maintaining and developing forecasting models, conducting scenario analyses and following up on payment milestones and financial commitments.
You will collaborate with stakeholders across different functions, ensuring that relevant information is collected, validated and documented. This includes understanding project payment cycles, such as payment certifications, invoice processing and advance payments, as well as identifying potential discrepancies or risks that may affect cash flow projections.
Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is structured, analytical and confident in communicating with stakeholders at all levels. You have the ability to build relationships across different functions and obtain the information needed to produce accurate forecasts, even when working with incomplete or unstructured data. You are proactive, pragmatic and comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities in a fast-paced and complex environment. Furthermore, you have strong organisational skills and can manage several parallel workstreams and deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Please submit your application for this role in English.
Qualifications:
At least a B.Sc. in Accounting, Finance or Business
3–5 years of relevant experience in cash flow forecasting within large construction projects and/or process manufacturing industries
Demonstrated experience in cash forecasting, payment scheduling, or financial planning within a project environment
Proven track record of working across multiple workstreams or packages simultaneously, coordinating inputs from diverse stakeholders
Strong command of Excel for model building and scenario analysis
Ability to interpret contract structures and understand how payment terms translate into cash timing
Solid understanding of large project payment cycle: certification, invoice processing, and advance payment mechanics

Meriting:
Prior exposure to large-scale infrastructure, EPCM, or complex construction projects strongly preferred
Experience with project management tools (ACC) is an advantage
Experience from cash management or other treasury collaborations

Contract type and hours
Full-time consulting assignment until 2028-01-18. Start 2027-01-19.
Let us help you take the next step in your career
Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/
You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36115 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

The opportunity 
Would you like to contribute to sustainable improvements and make quality a natural part of everyday operations? As a Quality Specialist at HV Breakers in Ludvika, you will work proactively to prevent quality deficiencies, investigate deviations, and develop clear and effective ways of working. In close collaboration with production and other support functions, you will drive improvements from analysis through implementation and follow-up.
This role is ideal for someone with an interest in quality and continuous improvement, who works in a structured manner and enjoys collaborating with others to understand and solve problems. Here, you will have the opportunity to contribute to stable processes and high product quality while further developing your own expertise. You will become part of a team of 16 Quality Engineers and Quality Specialists and report to the Production Quality Manager.
How you’ll make an impact
Lead non-conformance investigations in collaboration with relevant functions, identify root causes, and follow up to ensure that corrective actions achieve the intended results.
Support production in quality-related matters and contribute to joint solutions based on quality requirements, established procedures, and operational needs.
Analyze quality data and recurring issues to prioritize and drive preventive improvement initiatives.
Develop and improve procedures, work instructions, and standardized ways of working in collaboration with relevant functions.
Coordinate quality cases cross-functionally and ensure clear documentation, ownership, and follow-up.
Share experiences and promote lessons learned to strengthen quality awareness and prevent recurring issues.

Your background
You hold a degree in Quality Management, Quality Engineering, or a related field, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through relevant work experience.
You have experience in quality management, operational excellence, or continuous improvement, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
You are experienced in investigating problems, identifying root causes, and following up on improvement actions. Knowledge of structured problem-solving methodologies and continuous improvement practices is considered an advantage.
You can compile and analyze information, identify patterns, and translate findings into practical improvements. Experience with Microsoft Excel and quality management systems is considered an advantage.
You work in a structured manner, take initiative, and follow through on your responsibilities. You collaborate effectively, listen actively, and can build alignment around problems and solutions.
You communicate clearly in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing, and can explain quality-related matters to a variety of stakeholders.

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​

Surgical Science is a global organisation and leading provider of medical training simulations and software solutions. Surgical Science is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market.
 
Together with healthcare partners and customers in more than 90 countries, we enhance patient safety and healthcare outcomes through evidence-based, state-of-the-art simulation technology that improves clinical proficiency and performance - enabling safe and effective training without putting patients at risk.
 
Our solutions are used by medical training centres, universities, hospitals, and the medical device industry for practice, assessment, and certification.
 
With offices in Gothenburg (HQ), Stockholm, Tel Aviv, Cleveland, Cardiff, Shenzhen and Hong Kong, we are a fast-growing and stable organisation in a rapidly evolving world. We foster a hybrid work culture that supports onsite and remote collaboration across teams and time zones.
 
As an ERP Application Specialist, you will be our in-house expert for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Working closely with Finance, Operations and IT, you will take ownership of developing our ERP into effective functional solutions, combining hands-on Business Central expertise with stakeholder collaboration and continuous improvement and maintenance.
 
This position will be based in our office in Gothenburg, reporting to Senior Director IT.
 
Job summary
Take ownership of Business Central and drive its continued development as the system expands across our global organization.
Partner with Finance, Operations, IT and other stakeholders to understand business needs, shape priorities and translate requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
Configure and improve Business Central across multiple global entities, including workflows, reporting, integrations, permissions and automation.
Assess solution options and recommend approaches that balance business value, cost, risk and long-term maintainability.
Ensure the system remains stable, well-configured and fit for purpose through effective system management, maintenance, testing, updates and governance.
Support reporting and integration needs, including Power BI, APIs and Excel-based reporting.
Provide second-line support and training, helping resolve issues and strengthen Business Central knowledge across the organization.
Maintain key system documentation and contribute to future ERP rollouts and implementations as new entities and functions are introduced.

 
Minimum requirements:
Minimum 3 years’ experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Dynamics NAV, ideally in a global, multi-entity environment.
Experience in similar roles, such as ERP/Business Central Specialist/Consultant, ERP Application Specialist, Systems Manager (Systemförvaltare) or similar.
Good understanding of finance processes and accounting principles, with experience configuring, developing and managing Business Central, including workflows, permissions, reporting and AL extensions.
Experience with Business Central administration, testing, updates and ongoing system maintenance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Strong stakeholder and communication skills, with confidence working across functions and countries and supporting, guiding and training users.

 
It is beneficial if you also have any of the following:
MB-800 certification
Experience from manufacturing or medtech industry
Knowledge of Power Platform, Power BI, APIs or integrations is an advantage

 
Benefits:
🌍 Global environment (English as primary language)
💻 Hybrid work
⌚️ Flexible working hours
🏩 Optional Private healthcare
💚 Wellness allowance (Friskvårdsbidrag)
🚲 Optional bicycle lease

 
Surgical Science as an employer
Surgical Science is a global and continuously expanding organisation. You will be part of a dynamic, creative environment where we make sure to allow all employees to influence and contribute with their own unique experiences and knowledge.
 
Guided by our core values -  curiosity, respect, and perseverance - we strive to empower our people by recognising their strengths, supporting their growth, and creating opportunities to make a real impact.
 
We invite you to join us on this exciting and meaningful journey - to shape the future of medical training and improve care for patients around the world.
 
Apply today!
If you think you would fit our fantastic team and enjoy our work environment, apply as soon as possible as recruitment is ongoing. Let us meet and work out together whether we are a match!We kindly request that you apply with a CV in English.

You'll work with electronics from the first concept all the way to a finished product that's ready to sell.
 
Location: Stockholm, Sweden (on-site) | Employment: Permanent, full-time
 
Who is your future team?
Our Stockholm R&D site has grown to more than 50 colleagues. We're still early in our journey but we are growing fast. That means you can help shape how we work while being part of the world leader in network video.
We develop network-based surveillance cameras. We work in projects together with engineers and designers from other departments such as mechanics, firmware and imaging engineers. We keep processes and control to a minimum, and ideas are welcome from everyone, not just from the top. Here, your voice is heard.
 
What you'll do as an Electronics Engineer
As an Electronics Engineer at Axis, you play a central role in designing, testing and certifying the electronics in products that help make the world safer and more secure. You'll be part of the project from concept to production, until the product you and your team built is ready to be sold.
Projects vary a lot. They range from 3-month concept studies, for example in sensor technology, to 2-year projects developing advanced cameras. Your work will include:
Designing electronics, including system design, schematics and component selection
Testing and verifying your designs hands-on in the lab, including soldering
Certifying the electronics so our products meet the required standards
Working across disciplines with engineers and designers from other departments
Following the product from concept to production

 
You'll get a lot of responsibility and freedom from the start. Your mentor and experienced colleagues will support you as you grow into the role.
 
Who are you?
You're curious with an interest in technology, and electronics is what you're most passionate about. You like to take initiative and enjoy working independently. You find it easy to reach out to people and build contacts. You're thorough and take the time to understand the problem you're solving, both the big picture and the details. You enjoy sharing what you know, you stay humble, and you're motivated by working in an environment that keeps changing.
 
What you need:
A university degree in a technical field, preferably electronics
A genuine interest in electronics development
Professional proficiency in English

Bonus points for experience with any of these areas:
Soldering and modifications at PCB (printed circuit board) level
Electronics measuring on PCB using oscilloscope and multimeter
Testing and certification related to EMC (electromagnetic compatibility), ESD (electrostatic discharge), safety, etc.
Knowledge of production

We're a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Your well-being matters to us. Our benefits include a company bonus, Friday cake, a wellness allowance, health insurance, and even your own Axis bicycle.

Ready to act?

Join us and be part of an ambitious team building the energy infrastructure of tomorrow.
What will you do at NYAB? 
As our Technical Procurement Engineer, you will work at the intersection of long-term sourcing strategy and practical project delivery, driving procurement for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. You get real responsibility from day one and a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side as you grow into the full scope of the role.
Your scope will include core components and services such as solar modules, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, batteries, subcontractors and related technical solutions.
In this role, you will: 
Own the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from early tendering and supplier evaluation to contracting and execution.

Negotiate with suppliers to secure competitive terms, balanced risk positions and strong contractual outcomes.

Evaluate supplier offers against technical requirements, cost, quality and delivery needs, working with engineering colleagues to clarify specifications and understand trade-offs.

Stay ahead of the market by identifying new technologies, suppliers and system solutions that strengthen our renewable-energy projects and make our supply-chain more resilient.

Drive procurement priorities against project requirements, schedules and budgets – and make sure we deliver.

You will act as our internal product owner, digging into specifications, drawings and technical documentation together with the engineering team until you know the product as well as the supplier does – and spotting opportunities for optimization.

About you
You are strongly goal-oriented, a self-starter with plenty of grit and a natural talent for making things happen. You bring commercial instinct, sound judgment and a genuine hunger to learn – both the technology and the art of dealmaking. For you, speed and precision go hand in hand: you take ownership of your commitments and willingly go the extra mile when it matters – while building trust with colleagues, suppliers and partners along the way.
 We believe you have: 
A master’s degree in engineering, preferably within electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or energy systems – recently graduated or planned graduation in 2027.

Previous experience from procurement, engineering, project work, construction, energy or another technically oriented environment. 

A strong interest in sourcing, supplier management and commercial negotiations.

Strong cost awareness and the ability to manage priorities within time and budget constraints.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

The willingness to travel internationally to meet suppliers and partners, and to visit project sites in Sweden and abroad.

It is an advantage if you have: 
Experience from sourcing, supplier contacts or commercial work.

Knowledge of solar parks, BESS or related energy infrastructure.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish.

Why work at NYAB? 
NYAB's greatest strength is our drive and the pride we take in our work. We all pull in the same direction – forward. We value people for their competence and initiative, and you get the freedom to act along with the accountability that comes with it.
Our entrepreneurial spirit is built on collaboration and commitment. We are a close-knit community where colleagues support one another, share knowledge and work together to find solutions when new challenges arise.
You will never work alone – you will have the support of colleagues and leaders, and plenty of room to grow.

Comprehensive health assessments 

Generous wellness allowance  -

Parental pay supplement

Reduced working hours – (Sw: arbetstidsförkortning)

A secure pension plan 

 
Ready to make it happen?
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and academic records. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

 Magali Boisjot, Head of Uptime Powertrain Purchasing

jobs.occupation: Junior Supply and Demand Coordinator Student position
jobs.description:
About the company
AbbVie is one of the world’s leading research biopharma companies, and we develop innovative treatments and sustainable care solutions for severe diseases within the focus areas immunology, neurology, oncology, eyecare and virology. Patient orientation is key, and the company aims to develop specialized treatments and medicines for unsolved health problems. Our vision is to improve the lives of people affected by disease. 52+ million patients in 175+ countries are treated by AbbVie’s medicines every year.
Your role
This is a student position as a Junior Demand & Supply Coordinator, where you will be part of AbbVie’s supply chain function for Scandinavia, covering four countries including Iceland. You will report to the Manager Demand & Supply Scandinavia and work closely with Commercial, Finance, Quality, Medical and Regulatory.
The role involves a lot of hands-on operational work, from order-to-cash to warehouse and inventory flows. Many of these processes are still manual and Excel-driven, and this is where you come in. Once you understand how things work today, your main mission is to make them smarter by using AI and other tools to automate repetitive routine tasks.
Key responsibilities
Identify and automate manual processes using AI, Excel and other tools
Monitor overall inventory, including stock management
Manage pharma orders together with AbbVie’s centralized service functions and external partners, including shipping and packing notifications, certificate uploads and backorder management
Monitor wholesaler inventory and handle exceptions with internal stakeholders
Maintain master data (price, material, customer) together with the central SAP service team
Carry out internal control activities and take part in internal and external audits
Contribute to various projects across the team

Qualifications
Ongoing university studies in a relevant field, for example in IT, engineering, supply chain, logistics or finance.
Strong interest in and hands-on experience with AI tools and Excel
Familiarity with ERP systems, such as SAP, is a plus
Fluent in English, and preferably one Scandinavian language, both spoken and written

As a person, you take initiative and drive your work forward on your own. You’re structured and have an eye for detail, and have strong analytical skills and a structured, administrative mindset.
You communicate clearly with colleagues across functions and countries. You’re quick-thinking and technically curious, and you enjoy figuring things out yourself, especially when it means making a process simpler or faster. You’re comfortable working independently but also thrive as part of a team in an international environment.
Location: Solna, Stockholm
Scope: 2 days per week. Hours/days of work could be increased during summer to cover the vacations.
This is a consulting assignment, where you will be employed by us at Clevry but work on-site with our client AbbVie.
About Clevry
For over 30 years we have been the change maker for a more soft skills driven work-life within talent acquisition, assessments and advisory. We operate globally with customers, consultants and candidates from North America to Singapore with headquarters in Brighton, Stockholm and Helsinki. At Clevry we have over 150 soft skills certified recruiters, business psychologists and experts at your service.
The process
Clevry thinks your soft skills are as important as your hard skills. Do you want to know more about your soft skills and how to optimize them?
As you apply for this position you have the possibility to answer a questionnaire from us about your soft skills. The questionnaire takes approximately 10 minutes to fill out and generates a feedback report that highlights your soft skills. This report can be used for both personal and professional purposes.
Both questionnaire and feedback report are sent to your e-mail inbox.
We screen candidates continuously and the position could be filled prior to last application date. If you have any questions regarding this position or this recruitment process, do not hesitate to contact us at linnea.tylenius@clevry.com. Does this role sound like a good match? Please apply today.

Are you goal oriented and have a passion for driving change while being customer centric?

We are looking for a driven Business Expert to join the Sales Management team in Market Group North Europe. In this role you will own key commercial processes and drive their continuous improvement to make the sales organization more productive, disciplined and effective. You will play a central role in strengthening business routines, improving use of tools and reports, and enabling higher quality execution across the sales organization.

What you will do
Own selected commercial processes end to end and ensure they run with consistency, quality and clear accountability
Drive continuous improvement in tools, reports and ways of working to increase productivity and simplify execution for the sales team
Strengthen process discipline across areas such as forecasting, account planning, CRM, CPQ, Value selling, customer experience (CX) and master data
Monitor process performance and key business KPIs, identify gaps and drive actions that improve execution quality
Prepare business insights, analysis and decision support materials that help leaders and teams act with clarity
Enable stronger adoption of tools and processes by translating changes into practical ways of working for the business
Act as a key link between business needs and process development, ensuring improvements are relevant and useful in day-to-day sales work
Support the sales organization in raising the quality of data, planning and commercial follow-up

We believe you have
To be a successful candidate you should hold a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent qualification in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering or another relevant field. You have experience from sales operations, commercial excellence, business support or similar business-facing roles. You have strong business understanding and a proven ability to take ownership of processes and improve them over time. Your communication and presentation skills are strong, and you combine analytical capability with a structured way of working. You are proactive, solution oriented and comfortable working across systems, data, process ownership and stakeholder follow-up. You know how to move between operational detail and the bigger business picture, and you are confident in challenging existing ways of working to make them more effective. You are curious as an individual and work collaboratively with others to meet shared goals.

You are fluent in both written and oral English.

We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements
